response.sql: WITH budget_totals AS (SELECT link_to_budget, SUM(cost) as total_cost, COUNT(*) as expense_count FROM expense GROUP BY link_to_budget), average_spend AS (SELECT AVG(total_cost) as avg_spend FROM budget_totals), above_average AS (SELECT bt.link_to_budget, bt.total_cost, bt.expense_count, av.avg_spend FROM budget_totals bt CROSS JOIN average_spend av WHERE bt.total_cost > av.avg_spend) SELECT AVG(total_cost) as average_total, SUM(expense_count) as total_expenses, AVG(total_cost - avg_spend) as average_excess FROM above_average
